svg.text: BBH implants: track · order · interval · walk · truth ·
→ the model uses it as its own thought
Implants never touch the model’s own weights; their readers and write directions are fitted to the host model.
Only the BBH implants and eyes also use a small fine-tune of the model (a few hundred examples at most) to
teach it the call format. Everything else runs on the untouched model.
